parameters.help_en: The OSS object URL in the HTTP request. When you use the SDK for Java to import a local certificate, pass the file stream to `ImportCertificateAdvanceRequest.setCertificateFileObject` and then call `importCertificateAdvance`. The SDK applies for an upload location, uploads the certificate to the OSS location specified by the platform, and automatically populates `CertificateFile`. You do not need to prepare a bucket or a public URL. The following example value shows only the format of the object URL after the upload
parameters.help_zh: HTTP 请求中的 OSS 对象地址。使用 Java SDK 导入本地证书时，将文件流传给 `ImportCertificateAdvanceRequest.setCertificateFileObject`，再调用 `importCertificateAdvance`。SDK 会申请上传位置，把证书传到平台指定的 OSS 位置，并自动填写 `CertificateFile`。无需自备 Bucket 或公开链接。下方示例值仅展示上传后对象地址的格式
